notes: The tuition figure of 178 euros/year comes from the Parcoursup page, which is aimed at French/European Bac holders; the page for extra-community students (maroc.campusfrance.org) states differentiated fees of 2,902 euros for a Licence year, but it is a general institution-wide figure, not stated specifically for this programme. The applicationChannel is given as fr-campus-france per the task (foreign-diploma applicants apply via Études en France). No document list or intake dates for this programme were found. The French B2 requirement is written as "Niveau de français requis pour s'inscrire à la formation : B2" (not soft wording), so it is a stated admission condition. The page also notes a general advised French certification (TCF/DELF B2/DALF) mandatory for the Etudes en France procedure, but this is a general procedure rule and not program-specific.

note.fr: Vérifiez sur le site de l'établissement les critères d'admission et le niveau de français exigé, ainsi que l'éventuel test d'anglais (TOEIC, TOEFL, IELTS).
note.en: Check the institution's website for admission criteria and the required French level, as well as any English test (TOEIC, TOEFL, IELTS).

evidence.quote: Chaque établissement fixe ses propres critères d'admission, il faut toujours vérifier le niveau exigé par les établissements en allant sur leur site web.
